The '''434 DeathHammer''', also known as the '''Model 434 heavy blaster pistol''', was a popular [[Heavy blaster pistol/Legends|heavy blaster pistol]] manufactured by [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc.]].

==Description==
[[File:Blasterpistola.jpg|thumb|left|180px]]
A compact [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]], the 434 earned the nickname '''"DeathHammer"''' from its loyal users because of its heavy [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]] plating (resulting in a weight of 1.2 [[Kilogram/Legends|kg]]) and deadly fire capability - rivaling that of some [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]].

Selling for 650 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], the DeathHammer was popular among [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]], [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] and other professional gunslingers on worlds such as [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Because of its near ubiquity within those professions, owners often decorated or modified their DeathHammers.<ref name="NEGWT">''[[The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>

==History==
The [[Kubaz/Legends|Kubaz]] spy, [[Garindan/Legends|Garindan]] used one of these pistols.<ref name="NEGWT" /> The [[Gunslinger/Legends|gunslinger]] [[Gallandro/Legends|Gallandro]] was known to use a Model 434 in combat.<ref name="So Uncivilized">{{SW|url=news/so-uncivilized-great-gunslingers-in-star-wars-part-2|series=So Uncivilized: Great Gunslingers in Star Wars|text=Part 2|nolive=1}}</ref>

During the beginning phase of the Swarm War, [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] gave [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] a DeathHammer after [[Raynar Thul|UnuThul]] took his [[DL-44 heavy blaster pistol/Legends|DL-44 heavy blaster pistol]].<ref name="Dark Nest III">''[[Dark Nest III: The Swarm War]]''</ref>

The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] operative [[Davar Hamalcal]] carried a DeathHammer [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] as part of his personal arsenal.<ref name="GG9">''[[Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim]]''</ref>
